# ToolBox4Devs — Full Technical Specification for AI Agents & Crawlers

Website: https://toolbox4devs.com
Architecture: 100% Client-Side React SPA / Static SSG
Data Transmission: 0 bytes outbound (all operations run in browser memory)
Pricing: 100% Free Open Source & Ad-Free
Total Tools: 69

---

## Tool Registry & Technical Specifications (All 69 Tools)

### 1. JSON Formatter & Validator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-formatter
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Format, validate, and minify JSON strings with configurable spacing.
- Inputs: Raw JSON string
- Outputs: Formatted JSON string or Minified JSON string
- Features: 2-space / 4-space indentation, JSON minification, syntax error position marker, one-click copy.

### 2. JSON to TypeScript / Model Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-model
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Convert JSON payloads into typed model definitions.
- Supported Targets: TypeScript (Interfaces/Types), Python (Dataclasses), Go (Structs), Rust (Serde Structs), Java (POJO), C# (Classes).
- Features: Handles nested objects, primitive array inference, optional field detection.

### 3. JSON to Zod Schema Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-to-zod
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Automatically infer Zod validation schemas from JSON objects.
- Features: Strict types, optionality handling, nested object parsing, schema export.

### 4. Large CSV & TXT Table Viewer (Up to 1GB)
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/csv-txt-viewer
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Advanced
- Description: View, parse, and analyze massive CSV or TXT files up to 1GB in a paginated table format directly in your browser with zero memory freeze.
- Features: Handles large files (up to 1GB+) without freezing the browser, customizable delimiters, fast paginated table view.

### 5. JSON to CSV & CSV to JSON Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-to-csv
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Convert JSON arrays to CSV spreadsheets or CSV files to JSON with nested object flattening and live tabular preview.
- Features: Configurable delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab), object unnesting/flattening, downloadable CSV export.

### 5. YAML <-> JSON Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/yaml-json-converter
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Bidirectional translation between YAML and JSON documents.
- Features: Real-time validation, alphabetical key sorting, 2-space or 4-space indentations.

### 6. cURL to Code Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/curl-converter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Convert cURL CLI commands into executable code snippets.
- Supported Languages: JavaScript (fetch), Node.js (Axios), Python (requests), Go (net/http), Rust (reqwest), PHP (curl).
- Features: Extracts headers, HTTP method, basic auth, URL params, and request body.

### 7. SQL Formatter & Beautifier
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/sql-formatter
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Beautify and standardize SQL queries.
- Features: Dialects (Standard SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL), keyword uppercase/lowercase toggles, indentation options.

### 8. GraphQL Formatter & Validator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/graphql-formatter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Format, inspect, and beautify GraphQL queries, mutations, and schemas.

### 9. Dockerfile & Container Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/dockerfile-generator
- Category: Generate Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Advanced
- Description: Generate production-ready, secure, multi-stage Dockerfiles, .dockerignore, and docker-compose files with built-in security auditing.
- Supported Stacks: Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Java, PHP, Static HTML/Nginx.
- Features: Non-root user enforcement, healthchecks, minimal Alpine/Debian base images, build cache optimizations.

### 10. HMAC Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/hmac-generator
- Category: Crypto Tools (crypto-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Calculate Hash-based Message Authentication Codes using browser Web Crypto API.
- Supported Algorithms: HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA384, HMAC-SHA512, HMAC-SHA1.

### 11. Bcrypt Hash Generator & Verifier
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/bcrypt-generator
- Category: Crypto Tools (crypto-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Generate secure bcrypt password hashes with adjustable cost factors, analyze hash structures, and verify plaintext passwords against existing hashes.
- Features: Rounds 4 to 16, salt generation, structure breakdown (algorithm identifier, cost, salt, checksum).

### 12. CIDR & Subnet Calculator

### 60. Safe Vector QR Code Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/qr-code-generator
- Category: Generator Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: 100% Safe & Secure QR Code Generator. Create infinite vector QR codes (SVG, EPS) and high-res PNGs with transparent background, custom shapes, and zero tracking.
- Inputs: Plain text, URLs, Wi-Fi credentials (WPA3/WPA2/WEP/Open), vCard contacts, Email, Phone, SMS, Crypto addresses (BTC, ETH, SOL), or Geo location.
- Outputs: Downloadable pure vector SVG, Encapsulated PostScript (EPS) for Adobe Illustrator / print shops, high-resolution PNG / JPEG up to 4096px (4K print), plus Base64 Data URLs and raw vector code.
- Features: 100% in-browser offline generation with zero redirect links (static QR codes never expire); custom module shapes (Squares, Dots, Rounded, Squircles); custom corner eye styles (Square, Rounded, Circle); transparent background support; Reed-Solomon Error Correction (L, M, Q, H); center logo / icon overlay with automatic Error Correction boost.

### 67. Password Strength Analyzer
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/password-strength-analyzer
- Category: Analyze Tools (analyze-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Analyze password security by calculating information entropy, estimating crack times, and detecting common patterns.
- Features: Entropy calculation in bits, crack time estimates for online (~100/s), offline (~100K/s), and GPU (~10B/s) attacks; common pattern and sequential character detection; character set breakdown (lowercase, uppercase, digits, special); visual strength meter (0–100 score); actionable improvement suggestions; copyable analysis report.

### 69. Faker Data Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/faker-data-generator
- Category: Generate Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Generate realistic fake data for testing using a pure client-side pseudo-random number generator.
- Features: 12 data type categories (names, emails, phones, addresses, companies, dates, IPs, hex colors, usernames, sentences, UUIDs, or all fields); three output formats (JSON, CSV, Lines); up to 100 records per generation; regenerate button for fresh data; international name diversity; zero external dependencies; one-click copy and file download.
